end.summary: Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
end.parentNote: Om practised spotting line direction and telling straight lines from curved lines, using examples such as a tree trunk, book edge, slide, and bangle. They first mixed up a tilted slanting line with a curved line, then corrected this by noticing that a slanting line can be tilted without a bend; this was reinforced later in the lesson. At home, ask Om to find standing, sleeping, and slanting lines around the room and check whether each line has a bend.
